Underlined heading style produces setext-style headings for h1 and h2

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"heading_style\":\"Underlined\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Main Title</h1>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
